options: A list of defects found during SIT
A minute-by-minute runbook covering every activity needed to move from legacy to live use
The original project charter
A security role mapping document
questions.explain: A cutover plan is a detailed runbook covering every step needed to move from the legacy system to live Oracle Fusion use.

questions.q: Why is a "freeze" of the legacy system necessary during cutover?
options: To permanently delete the legacy system
Because Oracle requires it as a licensing condition
Because final balances would already be stale if the legacy system kept moving after the data extract was taken
To prevent business users from logging into Oracle Fusion
questions.explain: The freeze stops new transactions in the legacy system so the final data extract reflects a clean, unmoving snapshot rather than becoming stale immediately.

questions.q: What happens at a go/no-go decision point during cutover?
options: The team decides whether to proceed to the next step or pause to fix a problem first
The project charter is signed
A new requirement is gathered
A configuration package is exported
questions.explain: Go/no-go decision points are checkpoints in the cutover runbook where the team decides whether to continue or pause based on validation results.

questions.q: What is the purpose of a cutover rehearsal (mock cutover)?
options: To permanently go live early
To skip the data migration validation step
To replace the need for UAT sign-off
To run through the entire runbook beforehand, grounding timing estimates and catching problems while there's still time to fix the plan
questions.explain: A cutover rehearsal practices the full runbook ahead of time, revealing realistic timing and catching issues before the real, high-pressure cutover weekend.

questions.q: What did Brightfield's cutover rehearsal reveal?
options: That the Executive Sponsor was unavailable
That the final data extract took nearly twice as long as originally estimated
That the legal entity structure needed to change
That UAT had never been completed
questions.explain: Brightfield's rehearsal revealed the final extract took nearly twice as long as estimated, allowing the team to adjust the real runbook's timing in advance.
